task.title: Preserve workflow-phase responses as task Attempt evidence
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/746 with an explicit tool-free task turn boundary that preserves a phase-assisted response in both session and task evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Prevalidate the active associated task, fresh Attempt ID, writable session, and phase bindings before provider work.
Persist a valid provider response as both an assistant turn and Attempt evidence.
Preserve only the human turn on provider failure or blank response.
Commit assistant and Attempt events atomically when a duplicate Attempt races after provider completion.

attempts.summary: Established RED task turn behavior coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused suite failed because execute_workflow_phase_task_turn did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added success, invalid preflight, provider failure, and durability-order tests.

attempts.summary: Rejected blank provider evidence before assistant persistence.
attempts.diagnostic: Substantive review found that session text accepted whitespace that TaskObservationText rejected, which could orphan an assistant turn.
attempts.patch: Validated TaskObservationText before assistant append and added a whitespace-only regression.

attempts.summary: Closed the post-provider Attempt race atomically.
attempts.diagnostic: Review identified a TOCTOU window where a concurrent duplicate Attempt could leave transcript content without matching task evidence.
attempts.patch: Added a version-guarded two-stream SQLite transaction and a race regression proving both-or-neither assistant and Attempt persistence.

attempts.summary: Held merge through false-green review limits.
attempts.diagnostic: Successful CodeRabbit statuses repeatedly reported review limiting and were not accepted as substantive exact-head evidence.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge unarmed until cooldowns elapsed and the repository verifier reported READY for the exact reviewed head.

outcome.summary: Valid phase-assisted responses become atomic transcript and task Attempt evidence while workflow lookup, provenance, transition, lifecycle mutation, and tool authority remain caller-owned or out of scope.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_runtime

lessons: Cross-aggregate evidence that must agree belongs in one storage transaction, not adjacent fallible appends.
Validate the stricter evidence type before persisting a provider response to a more permissive transcript type.
Preflight checks improve failure ordering but do not replace in-transaction concurrency guards.
A green rate-limited review status is not substantive exact-head review evidence.
